entities.name: Pierre Nicolas d'Incarville
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre Nicolas Le Chéron d'Incarville was a French Jesuit and amateur botanist. He was a missionary to China and was the first person to introduce several important plants to the West. During his stay, he was also actively involved in publishing scholarly material on China.
